answer: Require every agent identity to post a $50 stake bond before it can trade. First, the bond is locked in escrow for 30 days while independent peers verify its work. Second, each verified task adds to a public atlas of its history, so reputation cannot be copied. Third, proven cheating slashes the bond and revokes the identity. Forging 10,000 fakes would therefore lock $500,000 for a month and risk losing it all, while a single honest agent reaches its zenith with one bond. Like rainwater vanishing into karst, cheap fake identities drain away instead of multiplying.
